input.question: When was St. John's Evangelical Lutheran Church built?

documents.text: It was built in 1901-1902 and is a brick building with a medium pitched gable roof , deep bracketed cornice , and semi-engaged tower in the center bay of the front facade in the Late Gothic Revival style church . It is a one-story building constructed of red pressed brick and wood frame , a high basement level , a high pitched gable roof , and two prominent towers of different heights . The front gable features a three part pointed arch window . The adjacent cemetery contains approximately 2,200 burials dating from 1821 to the present.It was listed on
